title: Treadmill incline intervals
coachNotes: 42 minutes of work against roughly 16 on 23 July. That gap is exactly why Thursday came in at load 42 against 65 planned: intervals.icu load is close to hours x intensity squared x 100, so RPE 8 inside a 47-minute session cannot score 65 no matter how much it hurts. EXTEND RULE: if the Garmin reads under 280 when you finish rep 7, add an eighth before cooling down. Garmin target 290-330. Zero descent by design, the entire week's descent budget is spent Saturday and Sunday. Thursday is a full rest day to pay for this.
